REMARKS/ARGUMENTS
Claims 1-5 are currently amended. Claims 3 and 8 are currently canceled. Supports for amendments of claims 1-5 can be at least found in FIGS. 1-8 of drawings as originally filed and paragraphs [0006] and [0019] of specification as originally filed. No new matter is entered.
Claim Rejections - 35 USC § 112
In the Office Action, claims 1-5 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112(b) or 35 U.S.C. 112 (pre-AIA), second paragraph, as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the inventor or a joint inventor (or for applications subject to pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 112, the applicant), regards as the invention.
I n response, Applicant currently has amended claims 1-5 to make them be definite, so as to overcome the rejections applied thereto.
Thus, Applicant submits that claims 1-5 in their current forms are allowable under 35 U.S.C. 112.
Allowable Subject Matter
In the Office Action, the Examiner pointed out that claim 1 as well as its dependent claims 4-5, are otherwise allowable pending the amendment of the above highlighted 35 USC 112(b) issues.
In response, the courtesy of which is thanked first. Applicant currently has amended claims 1-5 to overcome the rejections under 35 U.S.C. 112(b), and thus currently amended claims 1-5 are allowable.
Conclusion
In view of the foregoing, the application is considered to be in condition for allowance. The allowance of the application is therefore respectfully requested.
If any question about this matter and further discussion is considered to be necessary, and/or any point remains at issue and is considered to be best resolved through an interview, the undersigned is reachable by email.
Respectfully submitted,
/Leong C. Lei, #50402/
-----------------------------
Leong C. Lei
Registration No. 50402
